Present Subjunctive (Presente de Subjuntivo)
Expressing wishes, doubts, emotions, and recommendations
Yo-present stem + opposite endings (-e/-es/-e/-emos/-en for -ar; -a/-as/-a/-amos/-an for -er/-ir)
Espero que tengas un buen viaje.
ehs-PEH-roh keh TEHN-gahs oon bwehn BYAH-heh
I hope you have a good trip.
Es importante que estudiemos todos los días.
ehs eem-pohr-TAHN-teh keh ehs-too-DYEH-mohs TOH-dohs lohs DEE-ahs
It is important that we study every day.
Indicative vs Subjunctive
Use Indicative for certainty and declared facts. Use Subjunctive after WEIRDO triggers: Wishes, Emotions, Impersonal expressions, Recommendations, Doubt, Ojalá.
Por vs. Para
Distinguishing cause/exchange/duration (por) from purpose/destination/deadline (para)
por (reason, exchange, duration, via) | para (purpose, recipient, deadline, destination)
Gracias por tu ayuda.
GRAH-syahs pohr too ah-YOO-dah
Thank you for your help.
Este regalo es para mi madre.
EHS-teh reh-GAH-loh ehs PAH-rah mee MAH-dreh
This gift is for my mother.
Present Perfect (Pretérito Perfecto)
Past actions connected to the present ('have done')
haber (he, has, ha, hemos, han) + past participle (-ado / -ido)
Hoy he trabajado mucho.
oy eh trah-bah-HAH-doh MOO-choh
Today I have worked a lot.
¿Alguna vez has estado en México?
ahl-GOO-nah behs ahs ehs-TAH-doh ehn MEH-hee-koh
Have you ever been to Mexico?
Simple Future & Conditional
Predicting the future and expressing polite requests / hypotheticals
Infinitive + -é/-ás/-á/-emos/-án (Future) | Infinitive + -ía/-ías/-ía/-íamos/-ían (Conditional)
El año que viene viajaré a Perú.
ehl AH-nyoh keh BYEH-neh byah-hah-REH ah peh-ROO
Next year I will travel to Peru.
Me gustaría tomar un café, por favor.
meh goos-tah-REE-ah toh-MAHR oon kah-FEH pohr fah-BOHR
I would like to have a coffee, please.
Acabar de + Infinitive (Just Did)
Expressing something that just happened
acabar (present or imperfect) + de + infinitive
Acabo de llegar a la oficina.
ah-KAH-boh deh yeh-GAHR ah lah oh-fee-SEE-nah
I just arrived at the office.
Acabábamos de terminar la reunión.
ah-kah-BAH-bah-mohs deh tehr-mee-NAHR lah reh-oo-NYOHN
We had just finished the meeting.
Llevar + Gerundio (Duration)
Expressing how long an action has been going on
llevar + time expression + gerundio
Llevo dos años estudiando español.
YEH-boh dohs AH-nyohs ehs-too-DYAHN-doh ehs-pah-NYOHL
I have been studying Spanish for two years.
Llevamos una hora esperando.
yeh-BAH-mohs OO-nah OH-rah ehs-peh-RAHN-doh
We have been waiting for an hour.
